items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I met him for the first time that day when we went over, but it was a very brief meeting

ctx.x: Yeah, well, now, did you ever -- let me see. Could you tell us about some of your encounters with Duke Ellington?

Oh, yes. I had -- I think I mentioned a long time ago, when my parents took me over to New York to see the Duke at the Apollo Theater? Well, I met him for the first time that day when we went over, but it was a very brief meeting, you know. But anyway, that's when I -- that's before even TV and what have you. This goes back to, oh, 1935, something like that.
Yeah, you told me you were about 19.
